description: Moves something placed (a canvas, prop, lamp or fan, or in your own room a label or door) onto another block's side, keeping its size, as near the side's middle as it fits; labels and doors go only on walls. Use edit_object to change what it shows, add_object for a new one. A zone can't move: remove it and add another. Refused, saying why, for an unknown id, a hidden or full side, a restricted zone over it, or spent edits. Costs one edit.

id.description: Its id, as look gives it

on.description: The block's side it hangs on

layer.description: -1 with side up is the room's floor, 16 with side down its ceiling

top.description: On a floor or ceiling, the way a picture's top points: north (the default), south, east or west. Ignored on a wall.

name: move_object
title: Move an object
